craft_evidence.owned: no (no owned factory claimed; "manufacture transparently in Europe")
craft_evidence.makers: yes, in product data: supplierName names AGENDA SRL / INCOM S.P.A (jeans), Cottonparadise, Lda (tees), SC ALEXTRICOT SRL (recycled cashmere), Impetus (boxer briefs), Insitepart (sweatshorts); most other styles show "ASKET HQ"
craft_evidence.mills: yes: Manteco (recycled wool coat and jacket), Candiani (denim), Kurabo (raw denim yarn), Tollegno 1900 (merino) named in product descriptions
craft_evidence.madein: 47/47 styles carry countryOfOrigin in product data (Portugal, Italy, Romania)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: "We founded Asket in 2015 in Stockholm, Sweden" (/about)
craft_evidence.process: yes: per-product traceability, cost and footprint published ("exhaustive supply chain traceability ... available on each product page"); mill-to-make chains in descriptions ("milled by Manteco, Italy, cut and sewn in Portugal")
craft_evidence.reasoning: Asket names its makers in product data and its mills in descriptions (Manteco, Candiani, Kurabo, Tollegno 1900), and states country of origin on every style. It owns no facility, which is the 3 step exactly. Its about page says garments are made "exclusively in Italy and Portugal" while its own product data lists Romania for several knits and the wool coat.
